title: File Tree
lede: Display a hierarchical directory structure with expandable folders and files, useful for illustrating project layouts.

examples.heading: Default
Active File
examples.description: A File marked `active` has no rendered example; its class string comes from the component's client code: the link's text is semibold and its icon reads gray-1000. The folder around it is open, the second file is a plain one.

examples.heading: Card
examples.description: A Tree with `card` has no rendered example; its class string comes from the component's client code: the page background, the smallest shadow, radius 8, padding 24 and 16px text. It holds an open folder with one file and a top-level file (no indent).
